items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: I was able to get a hold of Garner to play with me at the Three Deuces... our very good friend, Erroll Garner.

ctx.x: Who were some of the -- did Tatum talk much about any of the musicians that he did like -- did you -- some of the people you know he liked.
Whom he liked, oh, yes. He talked -- he talked about Erroll Garner and --
I know he liked Fats Waller.
